title: Roasted Middle Eastern Cabbage with Baba Ganoush
description: A flavorful and healthy side dish that pairs perfectly with grilled meats. Roasted cabbage is served with a creamy baba ganoush dip.
instructions: Remove the tough outer leaves from the cabbage head and cut it into wedges.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, and lemon juice.
Add the cabbage wedges to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Place the cabbage wedges on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until tender and caramelized.
Meanwhile, warm the baba ganoush according to package instructions.
Serve the roasted cabbage wedges with the warm baba ganoush dip.
